catalyst_text: Presented positive Phase 1/2 data at ESMO congress
detailed_catalyst_text: Updated Phase 1/2 results in desmoid tumors were presented at ESMO 2026, showing a 72.2% objective response rate at a 32-week landmark among response-evaluable patients starting at ≥450 mg and a 100% disease control rate across all such patients. Safety was favorable with mostly low-grade TRAEs and no discontinuations, supporting dose selection and registrational planning.
catalyst_text_evidence: Parabilis Medicines (Nasdaq: PBLS), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to creating extraordinary medicines for patients with serious diseases by unlocking historically undruggable targets, today announced updated safety and efficacy data for zolucatetide, the first and only direct inhibitor of the β-catenin:TCF interaction, in patients with desmoid tumors. The data were presented today in an oral presentation at the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) Congress 2026, taking place 2026-10-23–2026-10-27, in Madrid, Spain. Among response-evaluable patients who began treatment at a starting dose of ≥450 mg, zolucatetide demonstrated an objective response rate (ORR) of 72.2% (13/18) in a 32-week landmark analysis. A disease control rate (DCR) of 100% was observed across all 46 response-evaluable patients who received a starting dose of ≥450 mg, with no disease progression. Zolucatetide continued to demonstrate a favorable safety and tolerability profile at the selected doses for Phase 3 registrational development. No patients discontinued treatment due to TRAEs.

catalyst_text: Announced dose ranging cohort initiation and positive data
detailed_catalyst_text: A new dose-ranging cohort was initiated within the ongoing Phase 1/2 study in adults with Familial Adenomatous Polyposis. Early clinical observations in FAP patients with concomitant desmoid tumors showed significant reductions in duodenal polyp burden with a favorable safety profile. These updates strengthen evidence for activity in FAP and help inform dose and schedule selection.
catalyst_text_evidence: Parabilis Medicines (Nasdaq: PBLS) ... today announced the initiation of a dose-ranging clinical cohort evaluating zolucatetide in patients with familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP) as part of the company’s ongoing Phase 1/2 clinical trial. Early clinical proof-of-concept data reported to date from patients with FAP and concomitant desmoid tumors enrolled in the ongoing Phase 1/2 trial support the therapeutic potential of zolucatetide in FAP. In two patients who underwent routine endoscopic evaluation while receiving zolucatetide, significant reductions in polyp burden were observed, from Spigelman Stage IV to a near-normal duodenum and from Spigelman Stage II to Stage I, respectively. Zolucatetide has demonstrated a favorable safety and tolerability profile to date.
